entities.summary: Len Ishmael is a St. Lucian development planner and geographer who was the Director General of the Organisation of Eastern Caribbean States from 12 May 2003 until the end of December 2013. She was appointed Ambassador of the Organisation of Eastern Caribbean States to the European Union in 2013, succeeding Shirley Skerrit-Andrew.
